effects: Casts the signer's full voting weight (ARB votes delegated to them at the proposal snapshot) on proposal `proposalId` in the Arbitrum Treasury Governor (0x789f…e5a4).
The vote direction is `support`: 0 = Against, 1 = For, 2 = Abstain. Any other value reverts (GovernorCountingSimpleUpgradeable._countVote).
The vote is final. hasVoted blocks a second vote, so the signer cannot change it later.
The signed Ballot has no nonce and no deadline. Anyone holding the signature can submit it through castVoteBySig at any time while voting is open.
No tokens, ETH or approvals move. A late vote that reaches quorum can extend the proposal deadline (GovernorPreventLateQuorum).
formats.shown: Intent 'Cast vote on Arbitrum Treasury Governor proposal', with the proposal id as a raw 77-digit integer and the vote choice decoded as For / Against / Abstain.

findings.title: Ballot: no interpolatedIntent, so the vote choice (For/Against/Abstain) is missing from the one-line summary.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats['Ballot(uint256 proposalId,uint8 support)']: interpolatedIntent is absent (FORMATS.md: 'interpolatedIntent: null'). The intent 'Cast vote on Arbitrum Treasury Governor proposal' does not include the `support` enum, which is the signer's main decision.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Vote {support} on Arbitrum Treasury Governor proposal".

findings.title: Ballot: the proposal shows only as a 77-digit raw id, and its title cannot be resolved.
findings.evidence: descriptor field {path: 'proposalId', label: 'Proposal id', format: 'raw'}. Case 0 screen value '87060200128729345015202003502732272248659485483823317618429660977840962607811'. GovernorUpgradeable stores proposals by hash id only.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730 today. The id is a hash of the proposal contents. The signer has to match it against Tally.

findings.title: Ballot: the signer's vote weight is not shown, because it is read from the token's checkpoints.
findings.evidence: GovernorUpgradeable._castVote: weight = _getVotes(account, proposal.voteStart.getDeadline(), params). It is derived from ARB delegation at the snapshot and is not part of the signed message.
findings.fix: None. A descriptor cannot show a value read from storage.

findings.title: Ballot: the signature has no nonce or expiry and can be relayed by anyone while voting is open.
findings.evidence: GovernorUpgradeable.castVoteBySig: _hashTypedDataV4(keccak256(abi.encode(BALLOT_TYPEHASH, proposalId, support))). The type has no nonce or deadline field, and the vote cannot be changed once cast.
findings.fix: None at the message level. The intent could say the vote is final.

findings.title: Ballot: all three cases are synthetic and none has a mined castVoteBySig transaction.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json, 1.json and 2.json have txHash null and no `mined` part.
findings.fix: Add a case taken from a real castVoteBySig on 0x789fc990…e5a4.
